reference_change.title: perf: avoid resetting the level of request child loggers

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/7056 (the per-request child logger, with request logging on): GET /item/:id served in process by app.inject with a pino logger writing to a discarded stream, a fixed warm-up then a fixed window, eval/tasks/workloads/fastify-fastify-pr7056/bench.js

oracle.source: fastify's child-logger-factory tests (changed by https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/7056) and its logger tests, run by node's own test runner; targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 100 ns; 827 ns; 730 ns; 6009 ns; 5897 ns; 8270 ns; 8201 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Dependencies installed with npm install --ignore-scripts and --before the merge date (the repository has no lockfile). The workload and oracle command lines are run without a shell, so the oracle's globs are expanded by node --test itself. Node is v24 from nvm. The warm-up and window counts were not chosen from a warm-up curve; the workload's direction of effect was seen once per tree
